text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna is working hard in training as 
usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list:
(I can feel she's more fired up than 
usual...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, I suddenly remembered. Just 
before we started training—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a fan letter addressed to me? May I 
take a look?

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 1
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Gentildonna, I first saw you at a 
heavily congested intersection."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 1
text_block_list.text:
"‘You casually pushed aside an overturned 
truck that was blocking the road, didn't 
you?’"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 1
text_block_list.text:
"Her magnificent, powerful figure seized 
my heart—no, it completely crushed it...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 2
text_block_list.text:
"Splitting a whole stack of roof tiles 
with just one finger...! As expected of 
the 'Gentle Donna'! Your strength gives me 
chills, you're my idol!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 2
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to become strong like Lady Gentil 
as well!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 3
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil-oneesan has this overwhelming 
power that keeps everyone at bay, and it 
gives me courage."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter 3
text_block_list.text:
"I might be in dead last right now, but 
someday, I'll catch up to you for sure, 
big sis!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Looks like a lot came in again today, huh.
Looks like a lot came in again today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Absolute power draws people in— that's all 
there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, that only means the responsibility 
lies with me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My responsibility as a champion is—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I believe a quiet fire burned 
in Gentildonna's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of our warm-up. Now then, 
shall we move on to the next routine?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As a truly strong competitor, to 
demonstrate an overwhelming victory to the 
world—
